key_insight: Predictive synthesis for MOFs and COFs aims to replace intuition-based trial-and-error with AI/ML-guided planning, moving toward real-time, transferable control of framework formation.
engineering_relevance: This enables faster, more reliable discovery and optimization of porous crystalline materials by turning complex synthesis variables into actionable experimental decisions.
method: Survey the evolution from empirical synthesis to AI/ML-assisted laboratory workflows.
Frame MOF/COF synthesis as a multidimensional prediction problem with interdependent variables.
Envision progression from static recipe recommendation to real-time control and generalizable formation principles.
evidence_signal: The abstract is a Perspective, so its evidence is conceptual and field-synthesizing rather than reporting new experimental benchmark data.
watch_item: Practical deployment may be limited by sparse, noisy synthesis data and the difficulty of transferring learned rules across different framework chemistries and lab conditions.
paper_title: Predictive Synthesis of MOFs and COFs
